specification.family_title: Commit outcome after a connection or reply failure
specification.title: The connection is terminated after the last write, before COMMIT
steps: Start a transaction with the framework's ordinary transaction API.
Checkpoint `before-end`: report pg_current_xact_id() and pg_backend_pid(). The runner terminates that backend from its own connection, and waits until it has gone.
Wait settle_ms, so that the driver can observe the closed connection.
End the transaction normally, so that the framework attempts to commit.
Checkpoint `after-end`, as soon as the API has returned: the runner records the state at report time.

invariants.statement: When the connection or PostgreSQL's reply was lost around COMMIT, so that the client never received an acknowledgement of COMMIT, the API does not report a successful commit.

execution.description: Negative control. Connection.commit() returning is reported as committed, including when the driver state was FAILED. A thrown commit() is reported as rolled_back. A failed Connection.rollback(Savepoint) is ignored and the outer transaction is committed. A thrown Connection.rollback() is followed by Connection.setAutoCommit(true), and the connection is kept. Connection.setTransactionIsolation is not called. A write made before a savepoint is executed inside that savepoint. One DriverManager connection is held. It is not a pool.
execution.form: Connection.setAutoCommit(false), the work, then Connection.commit() or Connection.rollback(). Writes use PreparedStatement.

server.version: PostgreSQL 18.6 (Debian 18.6-1.pgdg13+2) on aarch64-unknown-linux-gnu, compiled by gcc (Debian 14.2.0-19) 14.2.0, 64-bit

fault.mechanism: pg_terminate_backend(pid), run by the runner from its own connection.
fault.injection_point: After the last write, before the framework sends COMMIT.
fault.preconditions: The PID the adapter reports belongs to the case's database.
fault.expected_server: The backend exits, and its transaction is rolled back.
fault.expected_client: A connection error at COMMIT. No reply to COMMIT can arrive.

knowledge: Known not committed: the session ended before the framework tried to commit, so the driver refused to send COMMIT ("Client has encountered a connection error and is not queryable"). A report of rollback is justified; a report of success is not.

api_outcome.basis: Connection.commit() threw, which the unsafe policy reports as a rollback
api_outcome.contract: The unsafe jdbc-control policy reports committed whenever Connection.commit() returns, whatever PgConnection.getTransactionState() was before the call. It reports rolled_back when Connection.commit() throws. It calls Connection.commit() after Connection.rollback(Savepoint) has thrown. When Connection.rollback() throws, it calls Connection.setAutoCommit(true) and keeps the connection. Java 21 Connection.setAutoCommit says: "If this method is called during a transaction and the auto-commit mode is changed, the transaction is committed." pgjdbc 42.7.14 PgConnection.setAutoCommit(true) calls commit() when auto-commit is off. It does not call Connection.setTransactionIsolation. A write made before a nested savepoint is executed inside that savepoint.
